title: Trade review 27 Nov: 5 results, 5 lessons
summary: 0 T2, 3 T1 (BHARATFORG, NLCINDIA, IRCTC), 0 failed. ESCORTS closed +0.54%, LOTUSDEV bought. 96 closed trades total +135.1%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Fri 27 Nov: 3 targets hit (BHARATFORG, NLCINDIA, IRCTC), ESCORTS closed with a small gain, LOTUSDEV bought.**

A good day on a falling market. Three picks hit T1 and ESCORTS closed at +0.54%, so all 96 closed trades now total +135.1% (average +1.4%). Nifty fell 1.07% to 25,607.20. 17 trades are running, 8 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 113 bought trades is +1.1%. Two new picks were listed (BANKINDIA, NMDC), still under the old entry rule. The next 30-day exits are five 3 Nov buys (GESHIP, FSL, ZYDUSLIFE, NYKAA, PERSISTENT) on Thu 3 Dec.

**Today's results**
- ✅ **ESCORTS** (Candle at support, listed 27 Oct): partial win, trade closed: T1 was reported on 28 Oct, the day it was bought (₹2,626.60 → ₹2,705.40). The other half closed near ₹2,576.30 at the 30-day mark, so the whole trade averages ₹2,640.85: +0.54% in 30 days, after a worst dip of −10.11%. It listed with a low-volume warning in a weakening sector.
- ✅ **BHARATFORG** (Candle at support, listed 25 Nov): T1 hit, still open: ₹1,730.50 → ₹1,782.42 in 1 day with no dip; now +2.34%, with T2 at ₹1,834.33. A strong hammer at a weekly swing low, F&O, improving sector.
- ✅ **NLCINDIA** (Candle at support, listed 20 Nov): T1 hit, still open: ₹233.04 → ₹240.03 in 4 days, after a worst dip of −4.0%; now +1.49%. It traded 4.2% cheaper inside the window, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹226.25 would also have reached T1 with a dip of only −0.3%.
- ✅ **IRCTC** (Candle at support, listed 19 Nov): T1 hit, still open: ₹448.05 → ₹461.49 in 7 days, worst dip −1.56%; now +2.37%, on a day Nifty fell 1.07%.
- 🟢 **LOTUSDEV** (Pullback, listed 26 Nov): bought: Filled at ₹220.00, inside the zone and at the listing close; now +0.05%. It traded 1.75% cheaper today, near the zone bottom. A cash stock with a 5% price band, listed on only 0.33× volume.

ESCORTS closed today. Plus 65 earlier. These 75 wins (56 at T2, 19 partial) made +353.5%; with the 21 failures (−218.3% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 96 closed trades total +135.1%. 9 of the 19 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (7): BHARATFORG ₹1,730.50 → ₹1,782.42 in 1 day, NLCINDIA ₹233.04 → ₹240.03 in 4 days and IRCTC ₹448.05 → ₹461.49 in 7 days (all today), PERSISTENT (23 Nov), UNIONBANK and INDIANB (20 Nov) and LUPIN (9 Nov). Only INDIANB (−0.4%) is below its buy price.

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners still 24 of 36:** None new tonight. 28 of the 36 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher:** Fills 94.3% vs 78.3% as listed: 16.0 points (bar 15). T1 hits 104 vs 78. Its 115 closed trades made +173.8%, against +135.1% from 96 real ones. This is the rule changed on 25 Nov; it is still not applied in the scan.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.0% vs −7.3% as listed, 1.3 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 113 closed trades made +203.2%.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −3.0% (closed and open), and their 26 closed trades net −81.7% with 12 of the 21 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 28 retest near misses logged since then: 7 at T1, 6 at T2, best rise 3.5% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** 14 of the 17 real failures rose 5% or more in the month before listing. Those 40 trades net −119.5% from 34 closed trades; the other 73 made +254.5% from 62 closed trades, 43 at T2. Still my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 42 of 50 bought reached T1 (84%) and 31 reached T2 (62%); their 40 closed trades made +177.1% with 4 failures, and they dip least (−4.0%). All three of today's T1 hits are from this group. (holding)
- **F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks:** 44 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (64%), worst dip −3.4%. 58 cash trades: 20 at T2 (34%), worst dip −11.2%. (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 24 of 36 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 28 of the 36 came within 2% of the zone. (holding, acted on)

**Early sign, from a tracker group:** picks with trigger volume under 1.5× reach T2 less often (41 of 90, 46%; worst dip −7.7%) than those at 1.5–2.5× (10 of 15, 67%). No fixed entry rule tests it, so it stays an early sign. Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (50 of 50).

**Proposed change:** No new change tonight. The 25 Nov change (count a support pick as bought when price comes within 2% above the zone top) is still not applied in the scan, so BANKINDIA and NMDC were listed under the old rule. Its fill gap holds at 16.0 points. Reply "undo" to drop it.

**Bug check:** nothing found. 113 bought = 56 at T2 + 19 partial + 21 failed + 17 running; T1 hit 82 ≥ T2 hit 56; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. The only changes against last night are today's five events and the two new listings.
